Name: Fruit Tree Honey
Author: CopperSun
Description:
Modifies bee houses to work with fruit trees in addition to flowers.

Optionally, download a version that checks for veggies and forage as well, or another version that further checks for [i]rocks[/i]! Yeah, you heard me. But [b]pick ONE version[/b] to download and [b]only one[/b].

[list]
[*]Yes, it works with modded trees, so long as what's growing on that tree has the "fruit" category.
[*]No, it will not work if anything else is modifying how bee houses work.
[*]No, it does not change how the value of honey is calculated. It's still { base honey sell price + (base flower/fruit sell price × 2) }. Expensive fruit = expensive honey.
[*]Pairs nicely with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11422]Fruit Tree Tweaks [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671]PPJA More Trees[/url]﻿.
[/list]
Interested in making your own mod? It's easier than you might think! Check out the [url=https://stardewmodding.miraheze.org/wiki/Category:Tutorials]modding wiki's list of tutorials[/url].

Want to make a crop that grows emeralds or fairy stones or any other rock? There's a tutorial for that! [url=https://stardewmodding.miraheze.org/wiki/Tutorial:_Making_a_New_Crop]How to make a new crop.[/url]
